title: 填志愿

series.next: Submitted at 4:58. 小敏 isn't telling. The results come in two weeks, and you fly home in one.

setting: 外公's front room, Friday, 4 pm. The university form closes at five. The whole family is round the old computer.

xiaomin.name: 小敏
xiaomin.en: your cousin, eighteen, top of the county

xiaoyi.name: 小姨
xiaoyi.en: 小敏's mother: trying very hard not to look

waigong.name: 外公
waigong.en: your grandfather, whose house this is

steps.narr: 小姨 and 姨父 are sitting side by side on the sofa. For once.

else.narr: 小敏 spoke first, that night in 北京. Her mum hasn't stopped looking at her since.

steps.narr: Friday, 4 pm. The form closes at five. Cicadas outside, and the whole family round 外公's old computer.

steps.en: I've filled it in. Nobody's allowed to look.

say.en: Tell 小敏: whatever she's put, you all support her.
answers: 不管你填什么，我们都支持你。
不管填什么，我们都支持你。
say.gloss: Whatever you put, we're all behind you.
say.tip: 不管……都…… = no matter what ..., still ... 支持 zhīchí = support.

fail.en: What do you think, has she put 北京?

answers: 小敏，不管你填什么，我们都支持你。
4.gloss: 小敏, whatever you put, we're all behind you.

steps.en: But 北京 is so far...

say.gloss: All right, all right. Not today.

ok.narr: Quiet. Just the cicadas. 外公 puts down his tea.

answers: 今天是小敏的大日子，别吵了。
4.gloss: Today's 小敏's big day. Stop arguing.

say.en: Ask 外公 what he thinks.
say.gloss: 外公, what do you think?
say.tip: 您怎么想？ = what do you think? 您 for 外公, always.

ok.zh: 我十八岁，离开这个小县城，去了上海。
ok.en: At eighteen I left this little town, and went to 上海.
It's only when you leave that you find out where home is.

ok.narr: He isn't only looking at 小敏. He's looking at you too: the one who lives far away.

answers: 外公，您一直没说话，您怎么想？
4.gloss: 外公, you haven't said a word. What do you think?

say.en: Ask her to show you, or tell her to submit it unseen.
say.tip: 看看 = have a look: doubled, it's gentle.

ok.narr: 小敏 turns the screen, but only towards 外公. He reads it, and nods.

alts.gloss: You don't have to show us. Submit it.

answers: 小敏，你愿意的话，给我们看看吧。
4.gloss: 小敏, if you're happy to, show us.

answers: 不用给我们看，相信你，提交吧。
alts.gloss: You don't have to show us. We trust you. Submit it.

steps.en: 4:58. Submitted. Only 外公 saw it, and he's smiling into his tea. 📝

else.en: 4:58. Submitted. 小敏 hugs everyone: you last, and longest. 📝
